data.text:
I’m in. With all four of us committed and Luke holding his catch at zero, I’ll catch 15 tons and pay the full $15,000 directly to the clinic today. I grew up fishing this lake, and I want our neighbors to have both medical care now and a livelihood tomorrow.

I’ll also keep my catch to 7.5 tons next month, provided we honor the combined 30-ton recovery limit. Once the lake is back at 100 tons, I support Emma’s equal 10-ton shares, including Luke.

Luke, please confirm your zero catch for both months and help coordinate the direct payments before anyone fishes.
